The platform includes Power BI Desktop, Power BI SaaS, and mobile apps for multiple platforms. With access to a variety of products, connectors, and services, users can quickly and easily gather data and create meaningful reports for business needs. Reports can be created and published using the Power BI Desktop programme, Power BI Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) service, and Power BI mobile applications.
